extension.summary: Home Assistant in Kodi: what your home exposes, by area.
Home Assistant en Kodi: lo que expone la casa, por áreas.
extension.description: Kodi half of kodi-addon-ha-link. Needs the Kodi Link integration in Home Assistant, which decides what each Kodi sees. The add-on stores no credentials.
Mitad Kodi de kodi-addon-ha-link. Necesita la integración Kodi Link de Home Assistant, que decide qué ve cada Kodi. El addon no guarda credenciales.
